title: Server data
summary: Yon can connect to a SQL database, to the FYLO document store and to Redis for you. You name them in `server/application.json`, and a Store class gets them with `Needs`. Values always go in as parameters: Tachyon refuses query text built from pieces. With FYLO, DataSource also reads and changes documents by id, scrolls through any number of them with a cursor, manages collections and runs a durable queue.
